tour.overview:
Moorea's interior is a world of jagged peaks, pineapple fields and ancient temples. In the Opunohu valley, the lush heart of the island, restored marae recall the Polynesian society that lived here before European contact, and the island's famously sweet pineapples grow on the slopes. From the Belvedere lookout, the two great bays of Cook and Opunohu lie on either side of Mount Rotui.

This private half-day takes you into the interior and around the coast with a local guide and a vehicle.

AT A GLANCE
• Duration: about 4 hours
• Start and end: your hotel in Moorea or the ferry terminal
• Type: private tour with local guide, vehicle and driver
• Booking: on request – we confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay only then
• Level: easy

WHAT YOU SEE
• The Belvedere lookout.
• The Opunohu valley and its marae.
• Magic Mountain.
• The juice factory.
• Cook’s Bay and the north coast.

WHY THIS WORKS
Your guide shares the island’s culture and plants, and a private vehicle reaches Magic Mountain’s steep track.

WHO IT SUITS
Families, couples and day visitors from Tahiti.

WHO MAY PREFER ANOTHER TOUR
For the lagoon, choose our Moorea lagoon tour.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION
The track to Magic Mountain is steep; the vehicle is adapted. Bring insect repellent for the valley.

days.name: The Opunohu valley, the Belvedere, the marae, Magic Mountain and the north coast
days.description:
What to expect: Moorea’s interior and coast, with a local guide and private vehicle.

Your guide collects you at about 8:30. You follow the coast to Cook's Bay, then drive up the Opunohu valley, past pineapple plantations and the agricultural school with its tropical fruit trees. You visit the marae of Titiroa and Ahu-o-Mahine, stone temple platforms in the forest where your guide explains ancient Polynesian religion and society.

At the Belvedere lookout, the classic view of Moorea opens over Cook's Bay and Opunohu Bay, divided by the sharp peak of Mount Rotui. A 4x4 track leads up to Magic Mountain, with a 360-degree panorama over the lagoon and the reef. You taste local fruit juices and liqueurs at the Moorea juice factory and pineapples at a plantation, then return along the north coast with its beaches.

SCHEDULE (approximate times)
08:30 – Pick-up.
09:00 – Cook’s Bay.
09:30 – Opunohu valley and the marae.
10:15 – Belvedere lookout.
11:00 – Magic Mountain.
11:45 – Juice factory tasting.
12:30 – Back at your hotel.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Combine with the lagoon tour in the afternoon.
• A hike to the Three Coconuts pass can be arranged.

INCLUDED: private vehicle and driver, local guide, tastings, bottled water, pick-up and drop-off.
NOT INCLUDED: lunch, tips.

Overnight: none.
Meals: tastings.

faq.question: How does booking on request work?
faq.answer: You choose a date and the number of travellers and send the request. Nothing is charged. We confirm availability and the final price by email within 24 hours, and you pay online only when the tour is confirmed.

faq.question: Is it a full day?
faq.answer: No, about 4 hours; it combines well with a lagoon tour.

faq.question: Can we do it from Tahiti?
faq.answer: Yes, as a day trip by ferry.

faq.question: Are tastings included?
faq.answer: Yes, at the juice factory and a plantation.

faq.question: Is it suitable for children?
faq.answer: Yes. Child seats are provided free of charge on request.

faq.question: Is it suitable for people with limited mobility?
faq.answer: Largely. Most stops are close to the vehicle.

faq.question: Can we hike?
faq.answer: Yes. Hikes such as the Three Coconuts trail can be arranged with a hiking guide.

faq.question: Is lunch included?
faq.answer: No. Your guide suggests a restaurant by the bay.

faq.question: Will we be taken to shops?
faq.answer: Only the juice factory, with no obligation to buy.

faq.question: What should we wear?
faq.answer: Light clothes, comfortable shoes, insect repellent and sun cream.

faq.question: What is the best time of year?
faq.answer: All year. May to October is drier.

faq.question: Should we tip?
faq.answer: Tipping is not customary in French Polynesia and is never expected, but a small gesture for excellent service is always appreciated.

faq.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faq.answer: You can cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before the tour. Until your request is confirmed, nothing is charged at all.
